component.name: Slugline
component.summary: Write screenplays in plain Fountain files

description.p: Slugline is a keyboard-driven screenplay editor. It reads and writes plain Fountain files — your text, on your disk, in a format any other program can read — and produces submission-quality PDFs in standard screenplay format.
An unedited file saves back byte for byte identically, so the editor never reformats work it was only asked to open.

ul.li: Every keystroke is appended to a crash journal; a session killed outright is offered back on the next launch.
Every save is atomic — the file on disk is always either the complete old version or the complete new one.
Rolling backups keep the last ten saves plus one per day for a week.
Changes made to a file by something else are noticed rather than overwritten.

description.p: Elements classify themselves as you type, Tab and Enter move between them the way screenwriting software has always done, and every command has a key.
Slugline makes no network connections of any kind. There is no telemetry, no update check, no account and no font download.

Faster scrolling on long scripts, caret position and text size in the status bar, library search and sorting, preview sizing controls, and a visible keyboard-focus ring. Fixes element-bar bridge traffic, find scanning while typing, and CI toolchain pinning.
Refined writing workflow, compact suggestions, responsive navigation, and more readable interface text. Fixes clipboard, saving, autosave, search, and external-change handling.
